blocks.t: 3) PCH1-01-CPU or PCH1-02-CPU Required for PCH1-01-CPU and PCH1-02-CPU Versions

If installing this PCH1-01-ROM-G game card into Main PCB versions PCH1-01-CPU or PCH1-02-CPU (printed just left of Edge Connector), a modification is required for proper operation. This modification will not affect previously released PlayChoice game paks and will be compatible with future game paks.
NOTE: Perform this modification using the diagram below as a reference.

On parts side of Main PCB 8 6 RR locate LS367A at position 4L. Clip PINS 11 and 12 as close to the board as possible, being careful not to dig into board or cut traces. Bend PINS outward so that they are nearly parallel to the board. ‘or
